criteria.text: A team calls an approved model through a shared endpoint, with its own quota, within a day of asking
criteria.how: Have one team request access and send its first request; time it.

criteria.text: An assistant answers from internal documents without showing anything the user may not read
criteria.how: Ask as two users with different rights and compare the answers.

criteria.text: Every prompt and response of a test session can be found and read by security
criteria.how: Run a session, then search for it in the logs.

criteria.text: An agent is stopped when it tries a tool or a change outside its policy
criteria.how: Give an agent a task that tempts it outside its policy and watch the refusal.

criteria.text: GPU usage and cost per team are shown for the month
criteria.how: Show the usage view to two team leads.

readiness: GPU servers or capacity for the test, with drivers supported
One use case, its owner and its data, cleared by the data office
The users with different rights for the retrieval test
The model or models allowed for the test
Where prompts and responses may be logged, and for how long
